secondary: other: bowl carried tilted > 45 deg in the rim grasp (707-967)
what_happened: Layout 9 (side-by-side fridge, narrow open right compartment), light wooden bowl_7, tomato, drumstick 010. Stage 0: tomato grasped 92, released in the bowl 154. Stage 1: drumstick grasped 347, released in the bowl 410 (stage 1 at 410, 256 steps, normal). Stage 2: rim grasp at 444-456 with the tomato pinched against the rim (width ~0.030), lift 0.576 m. The bowl tilted past 45 deg at 707 and was carried that way. At the fridge (~840) the arm raised it to the TOP shelf (carrot distractor on it) and spent ~125 steps (840-964) at the front edge of that shelf, fingers working (0.03-0.05), the bowl tilted and only partly over the shelf. At 968 the gripper opened (0.047 -> 0.078) with the bowl 3 cm outside the interior; it fell past the lower shelves to the floor (drop 1.42 m), spilling both foods. 980-1700 the empty arm stayed at the fridge.
causal_chain: rim grasp, bowl tilted > 45 deg during the carry (707) -> raised to the top shelf and held at its front edge for ~125 steps (840-964) -> gripper opened with the bowl not on the shelf (968) -> bowl fell to the floor and the foods spilled -> stages 0/1/2 lost
self_recovery: Some re-positioning at the top shelf edge 840-964 (finger width changes); it did not get the bowl onto the shelf.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 1 shows ~30 'undone' events 673-893 while the bowl is carried tilted. These are not real spills: the foods stay in the bowl (visible in the wrist view), but the tilt pushes their xy offset past 0.7 x the bowl radius, or the tomato touches the fingers.
